description: 3 known facts, 2 questions to explore, and 1 question about the learning

name: 5-3-1 (alone, pair, group)
description: Brainstorm five individually, refine three in pairs, and agree on one in groups

name: Acrostics
description: Use each letter of a key concept to generate a descriptor

name: Admit Ticket
description: Answer a prerequisite or previous-learning prompt on entry

name: Alphabet Response
description: Generate facts or descriptors using assigned letters

name: Alphabet Sequential Round Table
description: Add words or ideas to a shared alphabet grid in sequence

name: Anticipation Activity
description: Respond to topic statements before learning and revisit afterward

name: Carousel Brainstorming
description: Move among chart prompts and respond to earlier ideas

name: Charades/Improvisation/Role Play
description: Represent or predict concepts with role play

name: Cloze Activity
description: Complete a short paragraph with key vocabulary from a word list

name: Concept Map/Word Map
description: Map definition, properties, examples and nonexamples

name: Dear…
description: Write a letter to a person or character about the focus

name: Frayer Model
description: Use definition, characteristics, examples and nonexamples for a concept

name: Gallery Walk
description: View displayed text or images and respond to specified prompts

name: Game On!
description: Answer lesson-related questions through a brief game

name: Give One-Get One
description: Record three ideas and collect two additional peer ideas

name: Illustration/Drawing/Cartoon/Tattoo

name: Imaginary Scenario

name: Journals
description: Respond in writing to a prompt about the lesson focus

name: KWL
description: Complete Know and Want-to-know before learning; Learned afterward

name: Kinesthetic Tic Tac Toe

name: Learning Logs

name: Meet and Greet (or “Speed Dating”)

name: Numbered Heads Together

name: Pass the Note

name: Plus/Minus/Intriguing
description: Mark statements agree, disagree, or intriguing and explain reasoning

name: Post-It Questions
description: Post questions about the topic and revisit them at lesson end

name: Quick Talk
description: Briefly discuss a focused issue related to upcoming learning

name: Quick Writes
description: Write rapidly about the topic for a set time

name: Questions to the Teacher
description: Generate three questions related to the lesson's focus

name: Read Alouds
description: Hear a short text excerpt that activates lesson-relevant thinking

name: Read and Say Something

name: Red Light Green Light

name: Sentence Starters/Prompts

name: Snowball Fights

name: Sorts

name: Stand the Line

name: Sticky Notes

name: StoryBoard

name: Think-Pair-Share
description: Think independently, discuss with a partner, then share

name: Think-Pair-Write
description: Brainstorm with a partner, then write independently

name: Think-Write-Share
description: Think, write, and then explain to a partner

name: Thumbs Up Thumbs Down
description: Signal an initial response to a targeted prompt

name: Transformed Text
description: Recast a text in another genre to capture core meaning

name: Turn and Talk
description: Discuss a tightly focused question with a partner

name: Twenty Questions
description: Ask yes/no questions to uncover a hidden topic or concept

name: Video Clips

name: What Ifs

name: What’s Missing?

name: Why, Why, and Why

name: Word Splash

name: Written Conversations
